استهدينا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَيْنَا (istahdaynā) /is.tah.daj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اُسْتُهْدِينَا (ustuhdīnā) /us.tuh.diː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
